info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Deposit Switch Integration API
info.description: The Deposit Switch Integration API facilitates seamless electronic fund transfers through various deposit switching mechanisms. Designed for financial institutions, this endpoint enables users to execute deposit transactions, ensuring efficient movement of funds between accounts. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service providers that require reliable deposit processing functionality. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their platforms with robust deposit management features, improving user experience and operational efficiency.

post.description: This operation allows users to initiate a transfer using the deposit switch feature. It facilitates seamless transactions by managing related account information and ensuring compliance with necessary protocols.
